title: Deep Source-Specific Packaging Lab
summary: Packaging Lab now deep-reads the actual current analysis, transcript, replay evidence and visual clues before drafting anything. Generic preset-style packages are explicitly rejected instead of being shown as filler.
discord_changes: Packaging Lab now sends the full current analysis and transcript into the packaging intelligence pass, not just a topic and a few summary fields.
Generic preset patterns are explicitly banned and deep Packaging refuses to fall back to template filler when cloud intelligence is unavailable.
Package evidence now shows why each title, thumbnail and hook came from this specific analysis rather than from a reusable YouTube formula.
changes: Added a high-specificity Packaging Lab mode using GPT-5.6 Sol with max reasoning and the full current transcript/analysis context.

Expanded package inputs to include video metadata, hook framework, hook story, summary intelligence, research intelligence, specific why-it-worked receipts, extracted content points, pacing, replay peaks, visual intelligence and up to 1,200 transcript segments.
Added a hard require_deep_specificity flag so Packaging Lab does not silently degrade into the old deterministic preset generator.

Banned generic title and concept shortcuts such as 'What the winners do differently', 'playbook from scratch', generic 'I tested X' framing, ultimate-guide language and vague before/after thumbnails unless the actual source evidence calls for them.
Required five meaningfully different creative territories rather than synonym-swapped packages.
Strengthened thumbnail instructions so outputs name source-specific subjects, objects, states and contrasts instead of generic layout advice.
Strengthened opening-hook instructions so hooks use transcript-specific facts, examples and tensions and are substantial enough to save real writing time.
Added an in-product depth check and source-evidence section explaining why each package came from the current analysis.
Preserved Package Library history so deep runs continue stacking into the expandable saved-package folders.
why_it_matters: A packaging tool is worthless if it simply swaps the topic into the same templates. The useful version should save the creator hours by doing the expensive thinking: reading the source, finding the distinctive tension and examples, translating those into original title/thumbnail/hook directions, and refusing to show generic filler when that work cannot be done properly.
